backproject_depth: backproject depth maps to 3D world coordinates using camera poses and intrinsics
augment_depth_cuda: augment depth point clouds with random rotation, scale, and noise on GPU
interpolate_feats_3d: interpolate 3D features from source to target point clouds using pointops
voxelization: voxelize point clouds by hashing coordinates and mapping points to voxel IDs
get_scannet_intrinsics: get Scannet camera intrinsics matrix adjusted for a given image size
